theme_strategy.rationale: Strictly adhering to the requested dark cybersecurity aesthetic. High-contrast, glowing accents, and jet black backgrounds to emphasize security and telemetry data.

rules: DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Always apply tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) for headings > 32px.
Overlines/Labels must use uppercase, tiny text, and wide spacing.
Use mono font (JetBrains Mono) for data, telemetry readouts, batch IDs, and numerical dashboards.
Apply colors functionally: #10B981 ONLY for Genuine/Safe/In-Stock/Verified. #EF4444 ONLY for Counterfeit, Recalls, Anomalies, and Low Stock.
NO generic full-screen gradients. Use matte, flat surfaces or subtle glows behind anomalous data.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for any overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Use solid #1F2326 or #1E2B4E.

surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look): Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse style layouts for telemetry grids.
Retro-Futurism / Terminal: Use for the spatial teleportation anomaly banners. Deep black backgrounds, high contrast borders, and monospace fonts.
Bento Grid / Flat Solid: Use for primary panels. Flat #1F2326 background, 1px subtle #E2E8F0/20 border, sharp or slightly rounded (max 4px) corners.
shadows: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or inner glows. Use tactical minimalism.
No muddy gray transparency. If glassmorphism is absolutely needed, use heavy blur with solid background opacity.

spacing_system.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Avoid cramped dashboards. Give breathing room.

grids.dashboard_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Use col-span-2 or col-span-3 for main charts (Telemetry Insights).
grids.landing_split: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 min-h-screen. Left: Pharmacy Portal, Right: Patient Trust Hub. Full height.

header_and_logo.description: Sticky top navigation bar featuring the official inline SVG logo alongside brand text.
header_and_logo.logo_specs: Build an inline <svg> replacing generic icons. Specifications: 4 camera viewfinder/scanner corner brackets framing a central vertical medical capsule. Top half of capsule has vertical barcode lines. Bottom half is solid with a cut-out checkmark. Render in stark white (#FFFFFF) on the #1E2B4E header.
header_and_logo.typography: Next to logo: 'KYRENIS' in bold #FFFFFF (Cabinet Grotesk), tagline 'SCAN-VERIFY-TRUST' below it in smaller #E2E8F0.

landing_gateway.description: Split screen layout. Two massive interactive zones. Left: Pharmacy Portal (technical, structural). Right: Patient Trust Hub (approachable but secure).

auth_gateway.description: Centered terminal-style card. Include 'Autofill Test Credentials' button prominently in #1E2B4E.

tabs.stock_intake: Form with visual 2D DataMatrix QR Output, OCR Text inputs, and DistributorNode selector.
tabs.pos_simulator: Checkout interface showing FIFO deduction logic in real-time.
tabs.replenishment: Governance panel. Highlight expiring items (60 days) in amber/crimson. Big 'Auto-Generate PO' action.
tabs.telemetry: Dashboard with Volumetric Saturation & Spatial Teleportation charts. Use Recharts. Show crimson anomaly banners.

tabs.batch_authenticator: Massive input area leading to a Giant Green Shield (Safe) or Red Warning Shield (Counterfeit).
tabs.openfda_directory: Accordion or dense grid of warnings, adverse_reactions, and dosage panels.

icons_and_assets.library: lucide-react (or @phosphor-icons/react for dense technical grids if added).

landing_bg.description: Dark cybersecurity network / operator - use at low opacity (10-20%) as a background texture for the landing page or auth gateway.

pharmacy_abstract.description: Clean glass test tubes / laboratory. Can be used as a subtle visual for the Pharmacy Portal side of the landing page.

icons_and_assets.rules: Never use placeholder images. If no image fits, use pure CSS typography and layouts.

rules: No 'transition-all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Hover states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and highlight border color.
Interactive feedback: Use scale down on click (active:scale-95).

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='pos-checkout-btn').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against #000000 or #1F2326 meets high contrast ratios. Use the provided #FFFFFF and #E2E8F0.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have a sharp 2px outline in #1E2B4E or #E2E8F0.

libraries.ui: lucide-react, shadcn/ui components (heavily customized to match flat cybersecurity aesthetic, rip out standard shadows and border-radius)

universal_agent_guidelines: DO NOT build a generic SaaS app. This is Kyrenis, an OS with a strict, dark, tactical cybersecurity identity.
Implement the custom inline SVG logo EXACTLY as described in the requirements.
Avoid standard Vercel/Stripe aesthetics. Replace soft shadows with sharp 1px borders.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk. Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and JetBrains Mono for data/technical readouts.
Ensure the telemetry dashboard actually visualizes 'Volumetric Saturation' and 'Spatial Teleportation' using charts (Recharts) with deep navy and crimson accents.
Do NOT center align the app container. Maintain a robust left-aligned grid hierarchy.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, forms, tabs, and critical status indicators.
